chunks: And ʿUmar ibn Yazīd narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever performs an independent ʿumrah may go out to his family whenever he wishes, unless the departure of the people on the Day of Tarwiyah overtakes him."

key_terms.أَهْلِهِ: his family or household to whom he returns
key_terms.خُرُوجُ النَّاسِ: the departure of the people for the hajj rites
key_terms.عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً: an independent ʿumrah performed separately from hajj
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the 8th day of Dhū al-Ḥijjah, when pilgrims set out for the rites of hajj
key_terms.يُدْرِكَهُ: it reaches him or he remains present until that time

ai.seo_question: Can someone who performs ʿUmrah Mufradah leave Makkah whenever they want?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for one who performs ʿUmrah Mufradah during the months of hajj. Such a person may return home whenever desired, unless they remain until the people depart on Yawm al-Tarwiyah, which affects their legal situation in relation to hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2938 - Umar ibn Yazid narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"Whoever performs an independent Umrah (Umrah Mufradah) may return to their family whenever they wish, unless they are still present when the people set out on the Day of Tarwiyah (8th of Dhu al-Hijjah)."
